messages:
Jill (design): Quick design review request — updated Compliance > Settings panel ready for UX nits. Main spots: retention wording, region selector fallback, KMS/encryption labels, and audit-log phrasing. Screenshot here: https://figma.redwood/example (small changes only).

Mike R.: Nice. Two quick concerns: the 'Auto-select nearest region' toggle reads like we move stored data. Users keep asking "does my data move?" Can we change label to 'Route requests to nearest region (storage location unchanged)' or similar?

Anya P.: For retention copy I prefer a clearer header: 'Data retention period' + help text: 'How long generated content and audit logs are retained. Regulatory requirements may apply.' Options should be: 30 days, 90 days, 365 days, Custom — and for Custom show an inline 'N days' numeric input.

Samir: KMS label currently shows 'Encryption: KMS' which is ambiguous. Suggest two explicit states: 'Encryption: Redwood-managed key (default)' and 'Encryption: Customer-managed key (KMS)'. Tooltip explanation: 'Customer-managed keys encrypt data with keys you control — Redwood does not have access to plaintext.'

Lena (QA): A11y nits: focus order currently jumps from Retention dropdown to Save button, skipping Region selector — please fix tabindex traversal. Also add aria-describedby to the KMS tooltip, role='tooltip' and proper keyboard focusability for the info icon. Contrast on the 'managed' badge is borderline per WCAG AA.

Mike R.: Audit log copy is terse. Example current: 'Key rotated'. Not helpful in enterprise audits. Proposed format (structured plain text):

```
KMS key rotation — user: jess@acme.com — key id: key-abc123 — result: old key retired, new key active
```

Also add event metadata: ip, region, request id. Keep the human-readable sentence at the start.

Jill (design): Good. For the KMS badge visual: small shield icon + 'Customer-managed' text. Make the badge interactive with aria-label='Customer managed key, click for details' and a hidden description exposed to screen readers that explains key access implications.

Anya P.: Region fallback messaging needs softness. Current copy 'Fallback to US-West' makes customers worry about data residency. Suggest: 'Requests temporarily routed to US-West to preserve uptime. Data storage remains in the selected region.' Also add a tooltip on fallback explaining why routing differs from storage.

Samir: Note on legacy data: older accounts might have a pre-1.2 flag 'kms_owner=true' in their profile export. We'll map that to show 'Customer-managed' in the UI. I'll open a PR to apply the mapping and add a migration test.

Lena (QA): Small checklist for PRs: 1) focus order test, 2) tooltip aria-describedby present, 3) badge contrast >= 4.5, 4) audit event sample added to fixtures.

Mike R.: Tiny copy suggestion for the retention dropdown helper text: 'Shorter retention reduces storage costs; longer retention may be required for compliance.' Keep neutral tone.

Jill (design): Action items: Samir — PR for legacy mapping + audit log sample; Anya — push final copy to Figma and update helper texts; Mike — change toggle label backend string keys; Lena — attach accessibility test cases to PR. I'll post acceptance criteria in the thread tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Compliance docs updated: https://docs.redwood/compliance/ui-retention-region-kms — automated note.

Jill (design): I'll follow up with a micro copy doc and a11y checklist in Confluence. If anyone wants to pair on the tooltip aria impl I can pair with frontend.
